items.title: $\tau$-Elicitation: Benchmarking multi-turn entity extraction in voice agents
items.one_liner: The tau-Elicitation benchmark reveals that voice agents struggle with exact multi-turn entity extraction, with recovery rates remaining low without structured scaffolding.
items.summary: Voice agents often struggle with exact multi-turn entity extraction for critical data like names, addresses, and dates. To benchmark this, researchers introduced tau-Elicitation, a 200-task benchmark across 10 entity types, showing that four tested voice configurations achieve robust exact success rates between 0.14 and 0.41. While agents verify hard or unfamiliar entities, only 24 to 37 percent of verified errors are successfully repaired. A structured scaffold prescribing spelling, read-back, correction, and confirmation raises robust Pass rates by 14 to 31 points at the cost of 21 to 28 additional seconds per call, highlighting strategy selection and recovery as the primary operational bottlenecks.
items.bottom_line: Voice agent entity extraction fails frequently due to poor error recovery, but structured verification scaffolds significantly improve accuracy at the cost of call duration.

items.title: SkillAtlas: An Attack Trace Library for Agent Skills
items.one_liner: SkillAtlas is a new public attack trace library for language-model agent skills, providing structured execution traces across multiple risk categories.
items.summary: Researchers have launched SkillAtlas, a hosted attack trace library designed to convert private security report bundles for language-model agent skills into reviewed, redacted, and searchable public cases. Unlike traditional static or sandbox evaluations, SkillAtlas captures risks emerging from model decisions, user context, tool calls, and execution feedback across multi-step traces. The initial release contains 3,014 cases, 6,589 traces, 151,131 steps, 233 affected skills, and eight risk categories. Analysis shows that 42.5% of successful attack cases only succeed after initial non-successful rounds, and incorporating trajectory-grounded labels improves pre-execution guard accuracy to 0.770.
items.bottom_line: SkillAtlas provides a comprehensive public library of multi-step agent skill attack traces to improve pre-execution guard accuracy and security analysis.
